description: Camel-compatible integration routes in Rust: runs Apache Camel YAML routes, EIPs and endpoint URIs with about 230 components; the integration layer for AI agents, serverless and edge.
rules: Write routes in the Camel YAML DSL (*.camel.yaml) unless the user asks for Rust; Apache Camel YAML routes run unchanged.
Look up a component's options on docs/components/<scheme>.md before using them; unknown endpoint options are rejected at startup, as in Apache Camel.
Put secrets in {{env:NAME}} placeholders, never inline.
Run routes with the Docker image pmsudhi/cameleer or the cameleer CLI (cargo install cameleer-main); there is no `camel` binary.
From Cameleer 0.3, validate generated routes with `cameleer validate <file> --format json` and fix every finding before running them.
Rust crates: cameleer-core (engine, Rust DSL) plus one crate per area (cameleer-http, cameleer-kafka-mqtt, cameleer-cloud, cameleer-saas, ...); cameleer-main bundles all components.
